comparison.objective: Top up line-side bins to maximum levels, versus tune and lock a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Title implies repeated item transfer into bins; body, manipulation rubric, and thresholds are absent. Candidate requires precision tool use and dynamic diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: Only the title supplies a maximum-fill goal; quantities, spill/overflow rules, and scoring are missing. Candidate has explicit energy, travel, rebound, damage, and retention criteria.
comparison.reason: Even with missing rubric details, bin replenishment is a clearly different objective from mechanical damper commissioning.
